subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman from <Picture 1>, preserving her facial identity and long, wavy dark brown hair, wearing exactly the outfit: a cream-colored oversized t-shirt, light-wash blue jeans, and white sneakers.

summary:
[reference generation] A 5-second parkour moment on a sunlit rooftop in three action-matched shots. <Subject 1> sprints left to right toward a waist-high concrete wall, plants one hand on it and vaults over in one quick continuous motion, lands in a deep crouch on the far side and bursts straight back into a sprint.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1] to [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - retain her facial identity, long wavy dark brown hair, and the casual cream t-shirt and blue jeans outfit throughout, with a focused, alive expression and lips parted in hard breathing. Her face stays sharp and undistorted in every shot. The fabric of her oversized t-shirt and her long hair must react dynamically to the wind and her rapid movements.

detailed_description:
Realistic live-action cinematic parkour footage, 16:9, bright golden-hour daylight falling on her from the front and the side so her face is always clearly lit, a flat rooftop with a waist-high concrete wall and the sunlit city skyline beyond, rich natural color, high clarity. HARD CUTS, and every cut continues the motion of the previous shot in the same direction, left to right. Everything plays at full real-time speed, every move quick, snappy, and explosive, with real weight and gravity: the vault rises and falls in one smooth continuous arc and her body is pulled down at once. Her movement is fluid and natural: long springy strides, arms pumping, momentum carried straight through the wall into the next stride. Her long wavy dark brown hair streams back behind her, and the hem of her cream t-shirt flaps dynamically in the wind. She does not speak, but her breathing and short effort exhales are audible.

[Shot 1] At 00:00.000, a wide shot from behind, camera locked off: she sprints across the flat rooftop toward the waist-high wall, arms pumping, long shadows ahead of her. Her long hair bounces with her strides. HARD CUT at approximately 00:01.700.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.700, a medium side-tracking shot, the camera travelling alongside her at the same speed so the framing stays constant. She plants one hand on top of the wall, her hips lift, and her legs swing over in one quick continuous vault that carries her straight down onto the far side. Her t-shirt rides up slightly and her hair whips around during the rotation. HARD CUT at approximately 00:03.200.

[Shot 3] At 00:03.200, a low medium shot from the front: her white sneakers come down hard past the wall, she absorbs the landing in a deep crouch with one hand brushing the ground, and bursts straight back up into a full sprint toward the camera with a hard exhale, quick and sharp, no loss of speed, until approximately 00:05.000.

overall_soundscape:
Distant city ambience, rapid footsteps of sneakers on the rooftop, the slap of a hand on the concrete wall, hard breathing and short effort exhales timed to the vault, a firm landing. Generate these physical sounds independently; no dialogue, no music.
